name: recipes4humans
description: Rewrites a recipe into a cooking view: one action per line, amounts on every use, prep made explicit.

scripts.dev: sh scripts/build-site.sh && cd worker && wrangler d1 migrations apply recipes4humans --local && wrangler dev --var PUBLIC_ORIGIN:http://localhost:8787
scripts.deploy: sh scripts/build-site.sh && cd worker && wrangler d1 migrations apply recipes4humans --remote && wrangler deploy
